site.name: SA Business Toolkit
site.tagline: Start and run a one-person business in South Africa
site.description: A free guide for one person who starts and runs a business in South Africa. Plain words, AI-checked facts, checklists and templates.
site.disclaimerShort: Written by AI, and checked by AI against the sources in the sources register. Not legal, tax or financial advice.
site.disclaimerLong: An AI assistant (Claude, made by Anthropic) wrote this guide. An AI checked the fees, thresholds, form numbers and legal rules against the South African sources in the sources register, where official ones are marked. No person has checked them. AI can still be wrong, and rules change often. Before you pay, sign or file something, open the official link and check the number yourself. This is general information. It is not legal, tax or financial advice.

wizard.title: Find my path
wizard.intro: Answer {total} short questions. You get the steps that apply to you, in order.

entity.question: How do you trade, or plan to trade?

sole-prop.label: In my own name (sole proprietor)
sole-prop.body: You trade under your own name. You do not need to register a company. You and the business are the same legal person.

pty.label: As a registered company (Pty Ltd)
pty.body: You registered a company with CIPC. The company is a separate legal person. It has its own tax and filing duties.

undecided.label: I have not decided
undecided.body: That is fine. You see the steps for both. You can change this later.

types.help: Choose all that fit. A food truck is a food business and also owns a vehicle.

templates.ptyNotice: A Pty Ltd must show its registered name and registration number. The law requires it.

taxInvoice.heading: The {total} things a full tax invoice must show
taxInvoice.supplier: Your name, address and VAT registration number
taxInvoice.recipient: The customer’s name and address, and their VAT number if they are registered
taxInvoice.numberAndDate: A serial number and the date of issue
taxInvoice.description: A description of the goods or services
taxInvoice.values: The value of the supply, the VAT charged and the total
